_help: Manifest of per-class recipe fixes that have LANDED in this tree.
The classifier reads this to distinguish 'this failure matches a playbook
class' (auto_recoverable) from 'a fix is in-tree AND is expected to build
on the next wave' (auto_recoverable AND fix_landed). See issue #560.
Shape of an entry under 'classes':
"<class-number>": {
"pr":       "<repo PR URL, or 'pending' before the PR is opened>",
"commit":   "<merge SHA on graviton, or null while parked>",
"coverage": ["<port>", ...],
"note":     "<optional; why coverage is what it is>"
The classifier sets triage_fix_landed=True for a port iff its triage_class
matches an entry AND the port is in that entry's coverage list. `commit`
may be null while the class PR is still open (parked, unmerged) --
fix_landed is a claim that the fix is *authored* in-tree, not yet a merge
marker. Once the PR merges, populate `commit` so an audit can cite it.
coverage is a per-PORT claim, not a per-class one, and it must list only
ports whose recipe is actually IN this tree: `git show graviton:
graviton/haikuports-patches/recipes/<port>-*.recipe` has to succeed. A
class PR that lands 3 of its 7 ports covers 3. Listing the held 4 is how
issue #560 happened a second time (see class 35's note, issue #592):
fix_landed=True with no in-tree recipe requeues a port that cannot have
changed, and the wave spends an attempt slot to re-derive the same failure.
Likewise `commit` must be a real object -- both class 27 and class 35 once
cited 528ed63c0a, which `git cat-file -t` rejects.

35.note: Four of the five class-35 ports, each with an in-tree recipe AND a native haikuporter RC=0 on a Graviton arm64 builder (#592): bebuilder-0.5.2~git-3, ftgl-2.1.5-3, qemacs-0.4.1~pre20170225-6, rssavers-0.2-3 .hpkg all produced. gri is DELIBERATELY EXCLUDED: its compile and link are clean natively, but doc/Makefile:893 requires tex+dvips to build refcard.ps/cmdrefcard.ps and nothing in the DeBeOS pool provides cmd:tex for arm64, so it has no native RC=0 and listing it would repeat #560. History of this entry: it once claimed ftgl, gri, qemacs and rssavers on PR 566, which was actually the class-27 PR; it was then emptied because no class-35 recipe existed in-tree. The native build also corrected the cross-compile triage in three places -- ftgl DOES have a class-35 site (FTVectoriser.cpp:169, against the real freetype), rssavers' '36 errors in Microcosm/extensions.cpp' do not exist (that file is not in the build), and rsHaikuScreenSaver.cpp compiles fine. Per-port triage and the one real bug in the set (bebuilder Kernel/FileWriter.cpp:43, a null-pointer Write the flag would have compiled): the playbook's Class 35 section.
